question: Where is my order? I haven't received it yet.
answer: You can track your order using the tracking number sent to your email after dispatch. Orders typically take 3–7 business days for standard delivery and 1–2 days for express. If your order was placed more than 7 days ago and hasn't arrived, please share your order ID and we'll investigate immediately.

question: When will my parcel arrive? It has been a long time.
answer: We apologise for the delay. Standard delivery takes 3–7 business days from the dispatch date. If it has been longer than that, there may be a logistics delay. Please provide your order ID so we can check the current status with our courier partner and give you an updated estimate.

question: How do I track my shipment?
answer: Once your order is dispatched, you will receive an email with a tracking number and a link to the courier's tracking page. You can also log in to your account and go to Orders > Track Shipment. If you did not receive the tracking email, check your spam folder or contact us with your order ID.

question: Can I change my delivery address after placing the order?
answer: Address changes are possible only within 1 hour of placing the order and before it enters processing. Please contact us immediately with your order ID and the new address. Once the order is dispatched, the address cannot be changed and you will need to arrange redirection with the courier directly.

question: My package says delivered but I haven't received it.
answer: Please check with neighbours or building reception as couriers sometimes leave parcels there. Also check around your doorstep. If it still cannot be found, contact us within 48 hours of the delivery notification and we will raise a formal investigation with the courier.

question: Do you offer express or same-day delivery?
answer: Yes, we offer standard delivery (3–7 days), express delivery (1–2 days), and same-day delivery in select cities for orders placed before 12 PM. Delivery options and costs are shown at checkout based on your pin code.

question: My order is showing as returned to sender. What happened?
answer: Orders are returned when delivery attempts fail (usually 3 times) and the parcel cannot be left safely. Once the item returns to our warehouse (5–10 days), we can either reship to a corrected address or issue a full refund. Please contact us to choose your preferred resolution.

question: How do I request a refund?
answer: We offer a 30-day return and refund policy. Contact us with your order ID and reason for return. We will send you a return label. Once we receive and inspect the item (2–3 days), your refund will be processed within 5–7 business days back to your original payment method.

question: I want a refund. How long will it take?
answer: After we receive your returned item and confirm it is in original condition, refunds are processed within 3–5 business days. Credit card refunds may take an additional 3–5 days to reflect depending on your bank. UPI and wallet refunds are usually instant.

question: Can I get a refund if I just changed my mind?
answer: Yes, we accept returns within 30 days of delivery for a change of mind, provided the item is unused and in original packaging. Certain categories like personalised items and digital products are non-refundable. Return shipping costs for change-of-mind returns are borne by the customer unless the item was defective.

question: I received a damaged or wrong item. What do I do?
answer: Please take photos of the damaged or incorrect item and contact us within 48 hours of delivery with your order ID. We will arrange a free pickup and either reship the correct item immediately or process a full refund — whichever you prefer.

question: My refund has not arrived yet. It has been 10 days.
answer: Refunds are usually processed within 5–7 business days. After that, your bank may take an additional 3–5 days to reflect the amount. Please share your order ID and we will check the refund status immediately and escalate to our finance team if needed.

question: I was charged twice for my order.
answer: Duplicate charges can occur due to a payment gateway timeout. Please share your order ID and transaction reference numbers from your bank statement. We will verify and refund the duplicate charge within 2 business days. No return is needed.

question: How do I update my payment method?
answer: Go to Account Settings > Payment Methods > Add New Card or UPI. You can save multiple payment methods and set any one as default. Changes apply to future orders only. Full card numbers are never stored — only the last 4 digits are visible after saving.

question: What payment methods do you accept?
answer: We accept credit and debit cards (Visa, Mastercard, Rupay), UPI (PhonePe, GPay, Paytm), net banking, EMI on eligible cards, and cash on delivery for orders below Rs 5000. Buy Now Pay Later options via Simpl and LazyPay are also available at checkout.

question: My payment failed but money was deducted from my account.
answer: The deducted amount is automatically reversed within 5–7 business days by your bank. Please do not attempt payment again immediately. Share your order ID and we will confirm whether the order was placed successfully.

question: Can I pay in instalments or EMI?
answer: Yes, EMI is available on credit cards with a minimum order value of Rs 3000. EMI options (3, 6, 9, 12 months) are displayed at checkout. No-cost EMI is available on select products. We also offer Buy Now Pay Later via Simpl for eligible customers.

question: The app keeps crashing. What should I do?
answer: Please try: (1) Force-close the app and reopen. (2) Check for app updates in the App Store or Play Store. (3) Clear the app cache in device settings. (4) Restart your device. If the issue persists, uninstall and reinstall the app. Share your device model and OS version if the problem continues.

question: The website is not loading or showing an error.
answer: Please try: (1) Hard refresh with Ctrl+Shift+R. (2) Clear browser cache and cookies. (3) Try a different browser. (4) Disable browser extensions temporarily. If the issue persists, share a screenshot and the error message and we will escalate to our technical team.

question: I cannot log into my account. The page just reloads.
answer: Please try: (1) Clear cookies and cache. (2) Try in incognito window. (3) Check if Caps Lock is on. (4) Try a different browser or device. If none work, use the Forgot Password link to reset credentials. Contact us with your registered email if you still cannot log in.

question: I am not receiving OTP for verification.
answer: Please check: (1) The mobile number is correct and has signal. (2) SMS is not blocked by DND settings. (3) The OTP can also be sent to your registered email — check that option on the login page. OTPs expire in 5 minutes so request a fresh one if needed.

question: How do I reset my password?
answer: Go to the login page and click Forgot Password. Enter your registered email and click Send Reset Link. You will receive an email within 2 minutes with a secure link valid for 24 hours. Check your spam folder if the email doesn't arrive.

question: My account is locked. How do I unlock it?
answer: Accounts are temporarily locked for 30 minutes after 5 failed login attempts. The lock lifts automatically. To unlock immediately, use the Forgot Password flow to reset your password. If your account was locked for suspicious activity, contact us for manual verification.

question: How do I delete or close my account?
answer: Go to Account Settings > Privacy > Delete Account. Confirm your password and reason. Deletion is permanent and cannot be undone. All order history and saved data will be deleted. Any pending orders must be completed or cancelled first.

question: How do I change my registered email address or phone number?
answer: Go to Account Settings > Personal Information > Edit. A verification OTP will be sent to the new email or phone to confirm the change. For security, only one contact detail change is allowed per 30 days.

question: I forgot my registered email address. How do I recover my account?
answer: Try logging in with your mobile number instead — go to Login with Phone. If you don't remember the phone number either, contact support with your full name and last order details for manual identity verification.

question: What are your customer support hours?
answer: AI support is available 24/7. Human agents are available Monday to Saturday 9 AM to 8 PM IST and Sundays 10 AM to 5 PM. Urgent tickets submitted outside hours are marked high priority and handled first when agents are available.

question: How do I contact customer support?
answer: You can reach us through: (1) This web form — fastest response. (2) Email at support@supportpilot.in — response within 4 hours. (3) Live chat during business hours. (4) Phone 1800-XXX-XXXX toll-free, Monday to Saturday 9 AM to 8 PM IST.

question: Your customer service is very bad. I am extremely frustrated and angry.
answer: We sincerely apologise for the poor experience and fully understand your frustration. Please share your order ID or describe the specific issue. A senior member of our team will personally review your case and reach out within 2 hours to resolve this.

question: I want to make a complaint. This is unacceptable service.
answer: We are sorry to hear about your poor experience. Please share your order ID, the issue details, and what resolution you are looking for. Your complaint will be escalated to a senior agent who will contact you within 2 hours. We take all complaints seriously.

question: Do you have a loyalty or rewards program?
answer: Yes! Our loyalty program gives you 1 point for every Rs 100 spent. Points can be redeemed for discounts on future orders (100 points = Rs 10 off). You also earn bonus points on your birthday, for writing reviews, and for referring friends.

question: Do you ship internationally or outside India?
answer: Currently we ship within India only. We are working on expanding international shipping. Sign up for our newsletter to be notified when international shipping becomes available in your country.

question: Can I cancel my order?
answer: Orders can be cancelled within 1 hour of placement through My Orders > Cancel Order. After 1 hour, cancellation is only possible if the order has not yet been packed. Once dispatched, cancellation is not possible and you would need to use the return process after delivery.

question: Can I modify my order after placing it?
answer: Minor modifications like quantity changes are possible within 30 minutes. Address changes are possible within 1 hour. Contact us immediately with your order ID. Once the order enters packaging, no modifications are possible.

question: My order status has not changed for several days.
answer: Order status can sometimes remain unchanged for 1–2 days during high-volume periods. If it has not changed for more than 3 days after dispatch, share your order ID and we will contact the courier directly and update you within 24 hours.

question: I ordered the wrong item by mistake. Can I change it?
answer: If placed within the last 30 minutes, cancel through My Orders and reorder. If longer, contact us immediately with your order ID. If already dispatched, accept delivery and use the return process — we will waive the return shipping fee in this case.

question: What should I do if only part of my order arrived?
answer: Partial deliveries happen when items are dispatched from different warehouses. Check your order details page — each item has its own tracking. If an item shows as delivered but is missing, contact us within 48 hours with your order ID and a photo of what you received.

question: Is this product available? It shows out of stock.
answer: Click the Notify Me button on the product page to receive an email when it is back. Most popular items are restocked within 5–7 business days. Contact us with the product name for a more specific restock timeline.

question: Is the product I received genuine and not counterfeit?
answer: All products are 100% genuine and sourced directly from authorised distributors. We have a zero-tolerance policy for counterfeit goods. If you have doubts about a product, share photos and your order ID and we will verify and take immediate action if needed.

question: The product I received does not match the website description.
answer: Please take photos and contact us with your order ID. If there is a genuine mismatch between what was advertised and what was delivered, you are entitled to a full refund or replacement at no cost.

question: How do I know what size to order for clothing?
answer: Each clothing product page has a Size Guide tab with measurements in centimetres for chest, waist, hip, and length. If you are between sizes, we recommend sizing up. Customer reviews often mention fit and sizing as well.

question: My product stopped working. Is it covered under warranty?
answer: Most electronics come with a manufacturer warranty of 1–2 years from purchase. Check your product box for the warranty card. For warranty claims, contact the brand service centre with your invoice. Share your order ID and product name and we will send you the claim process.

question: The product I bought is defective. It broke within a week.
answer: A product failing within a week is covered under our 30-day defective product policy. Contact us with your order ID and photos or a short video of the defect. We will arrange a free pickup and send a replacement or process a full refund — your choice.

question: My coupon code is not working. What should I do?
answer: Please check: (1) The code is entered exactly as given — it is case-sensitive. (2) The coupon has not expired. (3) Your cart meets the minimum order value. (4) The coupon applies to items in your cart. Share the code and a screenshot if it still doesn't work.

question: Can I use multiple coupon codes on one order?
answer: Only one coupon code can be applied per order. However, you can combine a coupon with a bank offer or with loyalty points redemption. Sale discounts are applied automatically and do not require a coupon code.

question: I forgot to apply my coupon code before paying. Can I get the discount now?
answer: Coupon codes cannot be applied after payment. If the coupon is still valid and you contact us within 1 hour of placing the order, we may be able to cancel and help you reorder with the code applied. Contact us immediately with your order ID and the coupon code.

question: How do you use my personal data?
answer: We collect only data necessary to process orders — name, email, phone, and address. We do not sell your data to third parties. You can request a copy, correction, or deletion of your data at any time through Account Settings > Privacy.

question: How do I opt out of marketing emails and notifications?
answer: Click Unsubscribe at the bottom of any marketing email. For push notifications, go to device settings > Notifications > App. To manage all preferences, go to Account Settings > Notifications. Transactional emails like order confirmations cannot be turned off.

question: How do I enable or disable notifications for my orders?
answer: Go to Account Settings > Notifications to manage all preferences. You can choose to receive order updates via SMS, email, and push notifications individually. We recommend keeping at least one channel enabled for order tracking updates.

question: I have a suggestion or feedback about your service.
answer: We love hearing from customers! Share your feedback by emailing feedback@supportpilot.in or through Menu > Give Feedback in the app. We read every submission. If your suggestion is implemented, we will reward you with loyalty points as a thank you.
